heading: Property network
intro: Keep property projects, service history and member conversations together. Projects stay with their authorized team. Your network profile starts private and is separate from the professional directory.
freshness_stale: Not current. A new check is needed.
reload_to_continue: Reload the current record before making another change.
error_access: This record is unavailable or your current account no longer has access.
error_conflict: The record changed. Reload it before making another change.
error_unavailable: This feature is not configured or temporarily unavailable. No success is confirmed.
error_fields: Check the fields and try again after reloading the record.
error_unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Reload to check the current state.
projects_intro: Follow work from planning to completion, with private progress photos, milestones and a dated record of what happened.
projects_empty: No projects are accessible to this account yet. Project owners can add existing verified members by their member code.
no_milestones: Progress not set: no active milestones
project_private: Private project: only the owner, assigned active members and authorized admins can view it. No public portfolio is created.
title: Project title
reload_before_new_project: The creation result is unconfirmed. Close this form and refresh the project list before attempting a new project; do not submit another copy.
read_only: Your current project access is read-only.
timeline_note: Entries form a dated record. Add a correction instead of rewriting an earlier entry. Photos and comments remain private to this project.
add_correction: Add a correction to the selected entry
correction_note: This entry corrects an earlier entry in the same project; the original remains in the history.
milestones_note: Progress comes from completed active milestones. Cancelled milestones do not represent completed work.
members_note: Add an existing active, verified account by its member code. This grants project access; it does not create an account, send an invitation or change anyone's global account role.
service_history_note: Progress from projects this account is authorized to view for this listing. Lease, tenant and financial records are not included. A listing reference is not a permanent physical-property registry.
photo_help: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each and six photos per entry. Photos require current project or post access. Removing an attachment here only removes it from this draft.
photo_invalid: Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP image no larger than 5 MB.
photo_unavailable: Private photo unavailable. Access may have changed.
photo_alt: Private photo attached to this entry
uncertain_submission: This entry's result is unconfirmed. Its exact text, photos and submission reference are retained. Reload the record to inspect it, or retry this same entry; do not compose another copy.
comment_photo_unavailable: A photo that is no longer available
comments_readonly: You can read these comments; posting is not currently allowed.
members_directory_note: Only members who chose member visibility appear here. Private professional drafts, account email addresses and phone numbers are not part of these profiles.
profile_separate: This is your member profile, not a published professional listing. Saving it does not claim or publish any imported professional profile.
status_text: Current status / what I am working on
visibility: Who can see my network profile?
visibility_private: Private — only me and authorized admins
visibility_note: Choose member visibility deliberately. Your account email, phone, private property projects and financial records are never added to your network profile.
wall_policy: Who can post on my wall?
wall_approval_required: Members can submit; I approve first
enable_comments: Allow comments on visible wall posts
save_profile_first: Save your network profile before adding posts. It stays private unless you choose otherwise.
wall_note: Wall visibility follows the profile. Photos stay behind authenticated access. Posts submitted by another member wait for approval before becoming visible.
your_wall_post: Post an update on my wall
wall_submission_note: Submit a post for this member to review. It will not appear to other members until approved.
wall_owner_only_note: This member accepts posts only from the profile owner.
block_note: Block another member's network profile and wall interaction. This does not replace project membership controls or revoke access to a shared project. Use the project team section to revoke project access.
leave_confirm: Leave this screen and discard the unsaved draft?
